document_metadata.title: 45、INT. COURTROOM - LATER
document_metadata.summary: The judge condemns the Ghostbusters as charlatans, expressing desire for harsher punishment, while supernatural activity escalates in the courtroom as the slime in the jar pulses, prompting the team to take cover.

entities.name: Louis delivers unorthodox summation in court
entities.description: Louis presents a disorganized and emotionally driven final argument in defense of the accused, referencing personal experiences and failing to meet legal expectations, which shocks the judge and observers.

entities.name: Judge rejects Louis's summation and reprimands him
entities.description: The judge expresses disbelief and anger at the quality of Louis's summation, calling it the worst he has ever heard and threatening contempt and disbarment.

entities.name: Judge finds Venkman, Stantz, and Spengler guilty on all charges
entities.description: After Louis's summation, the judge rules the defendants guilty of conspiracy, fraud, and willful destruction of public property, convicting them on all counts.

entities.name: Judge sentences the defendants to fines and imprisonment
entities.description: The judge imposes a penalty of $25,000 in fines per defendant and sentences each to eighteen months in Ryker's Island correctional facility.

entities.name: Court Trial Of Venkman, Stantz, And Spengler
entities.description: A formal legal proceeding in which Peter Venkman, Raymond Stantz, and Egon Spengler are tried on charges of conspiracy, fraud, and destruction of public property, culminating in a verdict and sentencing.
entities.summary: A formal legal proceeding in which Peter Venkman, Raymond Stantz, and Egon Spengler are tried on charges of conspiracy, fraud, and destruction of public property, culminating in a verdict and sentencing.

entities.name: courtroom

entities.name: Ryker'S Island
entities.description: A named correctional facility where the defendants are sentenced to serve time.
entities.summary: A named correctional facility where the defendants are sentenced to serve time.

entities.name: Louis Tully
entities.description: The defense counsel representing Venkman, Stantz, and Spengler in court, who delivers an unorthodox and ineffective summation.
entities.summary: Various characters, including lawyers and onlookers, react to supernatural events in and around a courtroom and garage, involving Venkman's trial, a chaotic courtroom disruption, and a mysterious odor in the garage.

entities.name: Judge
entities.description: The presiding judicial officer in the trial of Venkman, Stantz, and Spengler, who rejects Louis's summation and delivers the verdict and sentence.
entities.summary: A skeptical judicial officer, nicknamed 'The Hammer,' presides over multiple hearings and the trial of the Ghostbusters, rejecting supernatural claims, dismissing cases under duress, and delivering verdicts.

entities.name: Peter Venkman
entities.description: One of the defendants in the court trial, a member of the group being prosecuted for conspiracy, fraud, and destruction of public property.
entities.summary: A former Ghostbuster hosts a psychic TV show, has a history with Dana, and is excluded from her case; he displays a sarcastic demeanor, lacks baby experience, and is among defendants in a trial, while objecting to a half-price service offer.

entities.name: Raymond Stantz
entities.description: One of the defendants in the court trial, who reacts with disappointment to Louis's summation and is found guilty on all charges.
entities.summary: One of the defendants in the court trial, who reacts with disappointment to Louis's summation and is found guilty on all charges.

entities.name: Egon Spengler
entities.description: One of the defendants in the court trial, who sarcastically praises Louis's summation and is sentenced alongside his colleagues.
entities.summary: A reserved, scientifically minded Ghostbuster involved in psychomagnetheric research, part of the team conducting parapsychological exams, legal proceedings, and promotional activities, who monitors teammates' health and intervenes in conflicts.

entities.name: disorderly pile of notes
entities.description: A collection of unorganized papers Louis searches through after being questioned about his summation, indicating his lack of preparation.

entities.summary: The institutional facility where the defendants are sentenced to serve their imprisonment, located at Ryker's Island.

entities.name: Judge delivers personal condemnation of the defendants
entities.description: The Judge expresses strong personal disdain for the defendants, denouncing them as fakes, charlatans, and tricksters who exploit innocent people, and laments the perceived leniency of modern law.

entities.name: Judge threatens extreme punishment beyond legal limits
entities.description: The Judge declares that if not bound by current laws, he would invoke historical forms of justice and have the defendants burned at the stake, emphasizing his contempt.

entities.name: Judge slams gavel as gallery reacts loudly
entities.description: In response to his own outburst, the Judge hammers the bench with his gavel while the courtroom gallery erupts in noise, amplifying the tension in the room.

document_metadata.title: 46、INT. COURTROOM - GHOST BATTLE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: The Ghostbusters retrieve their equipment, confront the Scoleri Brothers, and successfully trap the vengeful ghosts using coordinated proton streams and tactical maneuvers in the damaged courtroom.

entities.name: Scoleri Brothers' apparitions emerge from specimen jar
entities.description: Two full-torso ghostly apparitions of the Scoleri Brothers violently erupt from a specimen jar in the courtroom, causing immediate panic and terror among those present.

entities.name: Judge recognizes the Scoleri Brothers in terror
entities.description: The Judge looks up at the towering ghostly figures and immediately identifies them as the Scoleri Brothers, expressing horror at their return from the dead.

entities.name: Scoleri Brothers break free from electric chairs
entities.description: The ghostly Scoleri Brothers, still strapped to their electric chairs and wearing electrocution caps with live wires, generate 2500 volts of electricity and tear through their restraints in an attempt to reach the Judge.

entities.name: Judge crawls to defense table seeking protection
entities.description: Overcome with fear, the Judge grabs his gavel and crawls to the defense table where Venkman, Stantz, and Spengler are taking cover, pleading for help against the vengeful spirits.

entities.name: Scoleri Brothers blast defense table with lightning
entities.description: After breaking free, the Scoleri Brothers turn toward the defense table and attack it with high-voltage finger-lightning, forcing those nearby to flee for safety.

entities.name: Prosecutor flees courtroom pursued by apparition
entities.description: The Prosecutor sprints toward the exit in panic as one of the Scoleri Brothers chases her, creating further chaos in the courtroom.

entities.name: Ghostbusters and Judge take cover in jury box
entities.description: Venkman, Stantz, Spengler, and the Judge retreat behind the jury box rail for protection from the attacking spectral entities.

entities.name: Judge dismisses case under duress
entities.description: Terrified and hysterical, the Judge recinds his judicial order and formally dismisses the case by pounding his gavel on the floor, pleading with the Ghostbusters to intervene.

entities.name: Courtroom Hearing Involving The Scoleri Brothers' Case
entities.description: A formal legal proceeding in which the Judge presides over a case that triggers the vengeful reappearance of the Scoleri Brothers' spirits, leading to supernatural chaos in the courtroom.

entities.name: jury box

document_metadata.title: 63、INT. MUSEUM - RESTORATION STUDIO - DAY (MOMENTS LATER)
document_metadata.summary: Dana notices Vigo's painting moving as he watches her; she catches the motion, becomes frightened, and quickly leaves the studio.

entities.name: Venkman sneaks up behind Dana in the art studio
entities.description: Venkman enters the studio and approaches Dana from behind without her initial awareness, observing her work on a painting.

entities.name: Venkman compliments Dana on her restoration work
entities.description: Venkman comments on Dana's skill while observing her cleaning a Ver Meer painting, leading to a brief conversation about its value and authenticity.

entities.name: Dana clarifies she is restoring not creating the Ver Meer painting
entities.description: Dana explains to Venkman that the valuable Ver Meer still-life is an original artwork she is cleaning, not a piece she painted herself.

entities.name: Vigo observes Venkman and Dana from the painting
entities.description: The figure of Vigo in the painting turns his head to watch the interaction between Venkman and Dana, suggesting unnatural movement within the artwork.

entities.name: Venkman mocks high-end art with a comparison to cheap reproductions
entities.description: Venkman jokes about the value of fine art by comparing the Ver Meer to inexpensive, mass-produced sofa-sized paintings available at a discount store.

entities.name: Dana questions Venkman's true reason for visiting
entities.description: Dana challenges Venkman's pretense of discussing art, implying he has another motive for coming to the studio.

entities.name: Venkman reveals he is still investigating Dana's problem
entities.description: Venkman informs Dana that he has not forgotten her issue and confirms that he and his team are continuing to work on the case.

entities.name: Janosz interrupts Venkman and Dana's conversation
entities.description: Janosz approaches the pair, smiling, and prompts Dana to introduce him to Venkman, shifting the dynamic between the characters.

entities.name: Dana introduces Venkman to Janosz Poha
entities.description: Dana formally introduces Peter Venkman to Janosz Poha, who is also working in the studio, facilitating their first interaction.

entities.name: Venkman and Janosz exchange cautious greetings
entities.description: Venkman and Janosz shake hands warily, each assessing the other, with Janosz avoiding direct eye contact and Venkman showing mild suspicion.

entities.name: Venkman inquires about Janosz's painting of Vigo
entities.description: Venkman approaches the painting of Vigo and asks Janosz about the subject, using a nickname that Janosz visibly dislikes.

entities.name: Janosz explains the historical significance of Prince Vigo
entities.description: Janosz describes Prince Vigo of Carpathia as a powerful 17th-century ruler, magician, and painter, defending his legacy against implied criticism.

entities.name: Dana expresses discomfort with the Vigo painting
entities.description: Dana criticizes Prince Vigo as a lunatic and genocidal madman and states she has felt uneasy since the painting was brought to the studio.

entities.name: Venkman suggests adding a kitten to the Vigo painting
entities.description: Venkman jokingly proposes altering the dark and ominous Vigo painting by adding a whimsical element—a fluffy white kitten—in the corner.

entities.name: Janosz阻止 Venkman from touching the Vigo painting
entities.description: As Venkman reaches toward the painting with a brush, Janosz quickly grabs his hand to prevent any contact, emphasizing the painting's preservation status.

entities.name: Venkman mocks Janosz's artistic conservatism
entities.description: Venkman suggests that making an exception to alter the painting would improve it, challenging Janosz's rigid approach to art restoration.

entities.name: Dana disapproves of Venkman's behavior toward the painting
entities.description: Dana gives Venkman a disapproving look in response to his attempt to joke about defacing a valuable historical artwork.

entities.name: Venkman bids farewell to Janosz and departs the studio
entities.description: After a tense exchange, Venkman says goodbye to both Dana and Janosz, calls Janosz by an unwanted nickname, and leaves the studio.

entities.name: Venkman teases Dana about having a crush on Janosz
entities.description: Before leaving, Venkman privately suggests to Dana that she may be romantically interested in Janosz, prompting her to dismiss him.

entities.name: Art Restoration Session In The Studio
entities.description: A collaborative work session in which Dana and Janosz are restoring valuable historical paintings, including a Ver Meer and a portrait of Prince Vigo, in a shared studio space.
entities.summary: A collaborative work session in which Dana and Janosz are restoring valuable historical paintings, including a Ver Meer and a portrait of Prince Vigo, in a shared studio space.

entities.name: art studio
entities.description: A physical workspace where Dana and Janosz are restoring paintings, serving as the primary setting for the scene.

entities.name: Peter Venkman
entities.description: A paranormal investigator who visits Dana at the art studio and interacts with her and Janosz.
entities.summary: Various characters interact in different scenes: a skeptic teases the next episode; a TV personality argues with his producer; a man buys a sandwich and a magic book; a team member exchanges sarcasm with Stantz and Spengler; someone walks with Dana, recalling memories; and a Ghostbuster expresses excitement about a new case.

entities.name: Dana Barrett
entities.description: An art restorer working on a Ver Meer painting in the studio, who is also being observed by the painting of Vigo.
entities.summary: A woman faces a paranormal threat involving her baby, seeks help from the Ghostbusters, and reconnects with Egon Spengler while confronting her past relationship with Peter Venkman.

entities.name: Janosz Poha
entities.description: An art restorer working on the painting of Prince Vigo, who is protective of the artwork and interacts warily with Venkman.
entities.summary: An art historian and restorer work on a painting of Prince Vigo, with the historian showing interest in Dana and the restorer protecting the artwork. A man mirrors the ghost nanny's features, suggesting a link, while Venkman has Winston guard a man called 'the wiggler.'

entities.name: Vigo
entities.description: A 17th-century Carpathian ruler depicted in a painting, possessing supernatural awareness and observing events in the studio.
entities.summary: A malevolent 17th-century Carpathian ruler depicted in a painting in Janosz's studio exhibits supernatural awareness, reacts to mentions of Dana's baby, turns his head to observe her, and controls Janosz.

entities.name: Ver Meer Painting
entities.description: A valuable original Flemish still-life painting by Ver Meer that Dana is restoring, worth about ten million dollars.
entities.summary: A valuable original Flemish still-life painting by Ver Meer that Dana is restoring, worth about ten million dollars.

entities.name: Vigo Painting
entities.description: A self-portrait of Prince Vigo, the Carpathian, being restored by Janosz for the Byzantine exhibition, imbued with a sense of malevolence.
entities.summary:
A larger-than-life portrait of Vigo the Carpathian, being worked on by Janosz Poha in the museum studio.
A self-portrait of Prince Vigo, the Carpathian, being restored by Janosz for the Byzantine exhibition, imbued with a sense of malevolence.

entities.name: Byzantine exhibition
entities.description: An upcoming museum exhibition for which Janosz is restoring the painting of Prince Vigo.

entities.name: Vigo observes Dana moving in the art studio
entities.description: From within the painting, Vigo turns his head to follow Dana as she walks back to her workbench, displaying awareness and tracking of her movements.

entities.name: Dana notices subtle movement in the Vigo painting
entities.description: Dana pauses and looks up curiously at the painting, sensing something unusual but not yet certain of what she saw.

entities.name: Dana catches Vigo's eyes moving and reacts with fear
entities.description: As Dana turns back toward the painting, she clearly sees Vigo's eyes following her, which frightens her, prompting her to flee the studio.

entities.name: Dana hastily exits the art studio after being frightened by the painting
entities.description: Overcome by fear upon realizing the painting is watching her, Dana quickly leaves the studio to escape the unsettling presence.

entities.name: Spengler and Stantz sing 'Cumbaya' to the slime specimen
entities.description: Spengler picks up a guitar and, at Stantz's suggestion, both he and Stantz sing 'Cumbaya' to calm the psych-reactive slime specimen, which responds by stopping its bubbling and beginning to shrink.

entities.name: Slime specimen stops bubbling and begins to shrink
entities.description: In response to Spengler and Stantz singing 'Cumbaya,' the psych-reactive slime specimen ceases its agitated state, stops bubbling, and starts to reduce in size.

entities.name: Spengler transfers slime onto a toaster
entities.description: Spengler uses a spoon to place a portion of the psych-reactive slime onto an old toaster to demonstrate its properties.

entities.name: Stantz plays Jackie Wilson's 'Higher and Higher' for the slime
entities.description: Stantz activates a cassette player, causing Jackie Wilson's song 'Higher and Higher' to blast from the speakers and trigger a reaction in the slime-coated toaster.

entities.name: Slime-activated toaster dances to music
entities.description: The toaster coated with psych-reactive slime begins to shake, spin, and move rhythmically in time with the music when 'Higher and Higher' plays.

entities.name: Dancing toaster ejects and catches toast
entities.description: While moving in time with the music, the slime-activated toaster shoots two pieces of toast into the air and catches them without interrupting its motion.

entities.name: Stantz turns off the music and stops the toaster
entities.description: After the demonstration, Stantz switches off the cassette player, causing the music to stop and the toaster to cease its movement immediately.

entities.name: Venkman dares the toaster to react
entities.description: After the toaster stops moving, Venkman sticks his fingers into the toaster slots and challenges it to do something, testing its responsiveness despite the slime being inactive.

document_metadata.summary: Dana adds bubble bath as the tub reacts violently, swallowing it and then closing like a mouth; she screams, snatches Oscar, and flees as the tub convulses and vomits slime.

entities.description: Dana carries the baby Oscar into the bathroom and places him in the bassinet, initiating the scene's sequence of actions.
